## New: Device and channel parameters

View your free@home configuration settings through the new **Parameters**
diagnostic sensors on each device. Settings update automatically when changed
in free@home; they are read-only in Home Assistant.

Find **Parameters** in the device's diagnostic entities. The sensor state is the
number of exposed parameters; the settings themselves appear in its attributes.
With **Create Sub-Devices** enabled for multi-devices, channel parameters appear
on their respective sub-devices, while device-wide settings remain on the parent.

[Documentation and template examples](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#device-and-channel-parameters)
